name: Koi to Tsumi
source:
"Don't hold out any hope for this world…"
"That's just how it is in the end, no matter where you go."
At that time, I was probably the happiest person in the world.
"Please, let me be part of your family!"
Living must be a wonderful thing.
"I feel at ease with you being here."
translation:
"Don't hold out any hope for this world…"
"That's just how it is in the end, no matter where you go."
At that time, I was probably the happiest person in the world.
"Please, let me be part of your family!"
Living must be a wonderful thing.
"I feel at ease with you being here."
